csv_scope_of_work: The Opa-Locka Community Redevelopment Agency ( CRA or OPA-LOCKA CRA ) invites proposals from experienced restaurateurs, developers, or operators to lease, build out, and operate a restaurant at CRA owned property located at 14401 NW 27th Avenue, Opa-Locka, Florida 33054. The building was formerly operated as a Chinese restaurant and is now a gutted shell with new windows.

title: Developer for CRA-owned Restaurant Redevelopment
short_description: Developer sought to lease, fit out, and operate a restaurant in Opa-Locka.
project_scope: Redevelopment of a CRA-owned former Chinese restaurant building at 14401 NW 27th Avenue. The existing building is described as a gutted shell with new windows. The selected team is to lease the property, complete the interior build-out/redevelopment, and operate the restaurant. No gross floor area, structural dimensions, or other technical characteristics are stated.
services: Developer/design-build services including architecture, programming, and civil engineering for restaurant redevelopment and fit-out, plus lease and operation of the facility.
relevance_explanation:
- Small restaurant redevelopment with no stated structural complexity or long-span/special structure aspects.
- Primarily a developer/operator opportunity rather than a focused structural engineering commission.
- Disciplines include architecture and civil engineering, but the scope centers on commercial fit-out and operation.
- Does not match sbp priority sectors such as bridges, stadiums, long-span roofs, or major cultural/university buildings.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available cost-related information is limited to CRA grant funding being mentioned. The project concerns redevelopment/build-out of an existing gutted restaurant shell with new windows, but no area, program size, or technical scope is provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible from the given information.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering fee is stated. Because the procurement is for a developer/operator to lease, build out, and operate the restaurant, and no construction budget or design fee basis is provided, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the given information.
references_qualifications: Proposals are invited from experienced restaurateurs, developers, or operators. No specific minimum reference counts, qualification classes, or technical reference requirements are stated in the source.
